Chennai Air Quality Dataset.
    This dataset contains air quality observations for Chennai.
    Important pollutants include PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO and O3.
    AQI is used as the main air quality indicator.

India Air Quality Dataset.
    This dataset contains air quality observations from Indian cities.
    AQI and major pollutants such as PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO and O3
    are used for analysis.
AQI values from 0 to 50 are classified as Good in this dashboard interpretation.
AQI values from 51 to 100 are classified as Satisfactory in this dashboard interpretation.
AQI values from 101 to 200 are classified as Moderate in this dashboard interpretation.
AQI values from 201 to 300 are classified as Poor in this dashboard interpretation.
AQI values from 301 to 400 are classified as Very Poor in this dashboard interpretation.
AQI values from 401 to 500 are classified as Severe in this dashboard interpretation.
